name: Session clipboard direction
description: Limits the clipboard in each direction to plain text. The host pool's RDP properties must still allow clipboard redirection (redirectclipboard:i:1), or the clipboard is blocked completely.
portalPath: Intune admin center > Devices > Configuration > Create > New policy > Windows 10 and later > Settings catalog > Administrative templates > Windows Components > Remote Desktop Services > Remote Desktop Session Host > Device and Resource Redirection: 'Restrict clipboard transfer from server to client' = Enabled, Allow plain text; 'Restrict clipboard transfer from client to server' = Enabled, Allow plain text (device scope, not the (User) settings)
reviewNotes: Values per direction: 0 disables it, 1 plain text, 2 adds images, 3 adds Rich Text Format, 4 adds HTML. Agree each direction with security and the users' representatives.
Hosts need a restart after the policy first applies.
Needs Windows 11 22H2 or 23H2 with the 2024-06 update, or 24H2 or later.

settings.displayName: Restrict clipboard transfer from server to client
settings.why: Session host to user's device: text only.

settings.displayName: Restrict clipboard transfer from client to server
